title: Intervals & Sweep Line

views.title: Intervals & Sweep Line
views.intro: First decide the sort key: by START for merging, inserting and overlap counting; by END for "keep the most / fewest arrows" greedy. Sweep line turns intervals into +1/-1 events; TreeMap handles online booking.
table: Sort by start, extend the last output interval
Sort by END, keep the earliest finisher
+1 at start, -1 at end, track the running max

files.desc: Merge, insert, non-overlapping, arrows, intersections, meeting rooms, sweep, car pooling, calendar I/III, employee free time, covered intervals, summary ranges

pitfalls: Half-open [s, e): process ends before starts at the same timestamp.
Touching intervals: decide up front whether [1,2] and [2,3] overlap.
Insert interval needs no sort when the input is already sorted: three phases in one pass.

decisions.a: Sort by start, extend the last output

decisions.q: Remove fewest to make the rest disjoint, or fewest arrows?

decisions.a: Two pointers, advance the one that ends first

calibration: SDE2 bar: merge intervals, insert interval, meeting rooms I/II, non-overlapping intervals.
SDE3 bar: sweep line with events, minimum arrows, interval intersections, employee free time, calendar problems with TreeMap.
Staff bar (for context): skyline with a heap or TreeMap multiset, interval trees for dynamic overlap queries, and offline processing of queries against intervals.
